channel.title: Said & Checked: Wisconsin — AskAmerica
channel.description: What officeholders said each day from or about Wisconsin, and which statements government data supports, contradicts or rules out.

item.title: Said & Checked, Wisconsin, 2026-11-20: none false or contradicted, 3 unsettled (Ron Johnson, Tammy Baldwin)
item.description:
No statement was found false or contradicted.

Unsettled

  • Ron Johnson, U.S. Senator: “That is President Trump's power. He's exercising his constitutional authority” Unsettled. The War Powers Resolution, as held in AskAmerica's U.S. Code table, conditions the President's use of forces on a declaration of war, specific authorization or an attack on the United States (50 U.S.C. 1541(c)) and requires withdrawal within 60 days without authorization (1544(b)), but 1547(d) leaves each branch's constitutional authority unchanged. Congress has not authorized the war, the administration says hostilities have terminated and the resolution is unconstitutional, and no binding ruling on this war has settled the question.
  • Tammy Baldwin, U.S. Senator: “forcing families to spend an additional $850, on average, since February.” Unsettled. EIA prices in AskAmerica's warehouse show regular gasoline averaging $4.09 a gallon since early March 2026 against $2.86 in January and February. Published estimates of the extra household cost differ by method, such as Moody's $860 for gasoline, diesel and jet fuel combined and Brown University's lower gasoline-and-diesel figure in May.
  • Tammy Baldwin, U.S. Senator: “Diesel prices have also hit record high, with some farmers shelling out nearly double what they paid just last year to power their combines and tractors and trucks.” Unsettled. EIA data in AskAmerica's warehouse show national retail diesel reaching a record $6.53 a gallon on Sept. 21, 2026, above the 2022 high of $5.81, but that is about 1.7 times the price a year earlier, not nearly double; farm off-road diesel prices were not available to test the farmers' figure.

8 statements by 2 officeholders. 5 checked: 2 supported, 3 unsettled · 3 not checkable.
